Vulnerable households receive timely multi-purpose cash and food assistance
Community-based targeting, registration and verification of vulnerable households
Monthly cash and food distributions to registered households
Post-distribution monitoring and complaints handling

Community MUAC screening and referral of malnourished children
Nutrition education and cooking demonstration sessions for caregivers
Farming and small-business households restore their livelihoods and income
Farming households receive seeds, tools and climate-smart farming training
Procure and distribute dry-season seed and tool kits
Farmer field schools on climate-smart and low-input agriculture
Households save, borrow and start small businesses through village savings and loan associations and grants
Form and train village savings and loan associations (VSLAs)
Business skills training and livelihood start-up grants

Cash-for-work rehabilitation of farm roads, irrigation channels and market sheds

Quarterly market linkage forums and price monitoring
